text_block_list.name: Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Pokke-san, Tachyon-san, Cafe-san,
Dantsu-san... That makes four of you in Team D.

text_block_list.name: Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Alright! For our next "Sports Nutrition" class,
you will be making nutritional energy rations with these teams.

text_block_list.name: Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Please work together with your team
to create delicious and nutritious energy rations~.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...What should we make?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Look at this group, alright? We'll never agree on anything.
Tachyon already ditched, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Let's just each bring whatever ingredients we want~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
T-That's true... Maybe that's actually a great idea!
We might end up creating something beyond our wildest imagination!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty! In that case,
I'll send a message to Tachyon-chan too!

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much~!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
When you think energy rations...
it basically means something that fires you up, right?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Then there's only one real choice~♪

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to nutrition, cheese is the best!
Plus, it goes well with any ingredient—

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger
text_block_list.text: Uwaaah! Why on earth did I make such a massive ordering mistake...?

text_block_list.name: Fishmonger
text_block_list.text:
Hey, young lady! Care to buy some of these?
I'll give you a huge discount~!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I see... you say this is necessary...
Then... let us wash it and dry it out.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Bring your own ingredients", hmm...?
For efficient nutritional replenishment, sugar is the only rational choice. However—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku... That alone would be far too mundane.
Let us add a little accent...

text_block_list.name: Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Looks like everyone worked together on the preparations! 
Now, let's begin cooking!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's just chuck the ingredients into the pot one by one.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: First up~, my cola!!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Is that even... a food ingredient?
...Add the mushrooms.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
A skull pattern...? 
W-What an interesting mushroom!
U-Um... I brought kusaya...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! What a magnificent stench!
And lastly, my sugar and... just a dash of chemical reagent!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Wh... Reagent?!
(KABOOOOOOOM!!!!)
One day, while walking down the hallway...

text_block_list.name: Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text: How did a cooking assignment turn into a massive explosion?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh? Cooking is just chemical reactions, is it not?
This much was well within expectations.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
! Ah, I see, that makes sense.
Then maybe if we try it one more time...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I believe it would be best not to.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
*yaaaawn*~~, count me out too.
I'm gonna go take a nap~.

text_block_list.name: Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Grrrr...! Aaaaaarrrgghhhhh!!!!!
...*gasp*...... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Nutrition Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Expecting you four to work as a team in the first place...
was pure nonsense, wasn't it...
